new: Small semicircles: (π/2)(3² + 4²) = 25π/2. By Pythagoras AB = 10 cm, so the semicircle on AB is (π/2)(5²) = 25π/2. Crescents = 25π/2 + 24 − 25π/2 = 24 cm², the area of the triangle.
why: 'semicircle on AB = 10 cm' equates an area with a length
